paragraphs: Nachshon. Anini bar Nachshon — Kohelet Rabbah 3:11.[^1]

notes.text: עניני is read as the personal name Anini in this name-index context, followed by bar Nachshon. It is not translated as “matters concerning.” קה״ר פ״ג-יא is expanded as Kohelet Rabbah 3:11; no named edition is independently verified.
